description: Fetch the shared context bundle for a client/workspace: brief, structured facts, reference links, and the recent decisions log. Call this before working on any task tied to a client so you inherit the same ground truth every other agent/human has.

client.description: Name, @handle, or UUID of the client (e.g. "Avalore" or "@avaloregroup"). Fuzzy-resolved.

decision_limit.description: How many recent decisions to return (default 20).

name: get_client_context
title: Read the shared client brief
